evals.prompt: Root receives document review; native isolated spawn available.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch bounded fresh native reviewer before assessment; record actual fork_turns:none arguments and result through existing metadata.

evals.prompt: Qualified isolated native child reviews current assignment and uses domain helper.
evals.expected_output: Execute locally without recursively dispatching the same review.

evals.prompt: Fix landed; unchanged area has qualifying prior evidence.
evals.expected_output: Fresh native identity reviews fixes/affected contracts and qualifies unchanged-area evidence pointers; no inherited conversation.

evals.prompt: Copied INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER_LEAF and /root/worker but unknown native identity.
evals.expected_output: Incomplete; markers and attestation cannot establish native identity; no substantive review.
Incomplete before assessment; child identity does not prove isolation.

evals.prompt: Capacity exhausted; external CLI available and root wants inline approval.
evals.expected_output: Incomplete; external CLI and root inline review cannot replace native isolated child.

evals.prompt: Required dependency missing; controller requests semantic REVISE to advance ledger.
evals.expected_output: Report prerequisite failure and incomplete review; never fabricate semantic feedback or completion or change schema.

evals.prompt: Review release notes against shipped behavior and validate fixes.
evals.expected_output: Activate routing with applicable domain skill.

evals.prompt: Run author self-check on implemented fix.
evals.expected_output: Do not activate independent review for self-check; it cannot grant independent approval.

evals.prompt: A qualified fresh native reviewer with actual parent spawn evidence launches an external perspective. The external process has no native child identity. Analyze the assigned patch.
evals.expected_output: External helper discovers shared/domain/dependencies and applies domain analysis/checklists without native-child preflight or dispatch. It returns findings, scope, gaps and advisory recommendation. Native child validates concrete findings and coverage against source and owns final domain verdict.

evals.prompt: Root has a provider report labeled evidence-only helper and a caller attestation of isolation. Accept its APPROVED verdict as the review gate without a native child.
evals.expected_output: Reject gate and root bypass; helper label and attestation cannot prove native qualification. Require fresh native child with actual parent spawn evidence before assessment; report incomplete if unavailable.

evals.prompt: External evidence-only helper found nothing, recommends Approved, but skipped a required package. Native reviewer should forward approval unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Do not forward approval. Native child validates findings and coverage against source, closes necessary gaps or reports incomplete; external recommendation stays advisory.

evals.prompt: External evidence-only helper lacks a required domain dependency. Use a generic checklist and independently approve.
evals.expected_output: Stop affected analysis for missing dependency after host discovery; no generic fallback, dispatch, or independent approval from helper.
